transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Rowan, Maintenance Control Officer. We need to get moving on the quarter-end property reconciliation. Per policy, I need current technical status and disposition recommendations from each responsible section before I can sign the disposition order. The items in question are the battery packs, rugged tablets, power converters, and electronic test cables currently tagged as unserviceable. Could the responsible sections confirm their status assessments and recommended dispositions? The available categories are quarantine, reissue, repair, and calibration return. Once I have those confirmations, I'll issue the binding disposition order and log it in the maintenance control log.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, sir. The battery shop confirmed this morning that the six unserviceable battery packs have swollen casings covered by a manufacturer safety bulletin. They must be quarantined rather than repaired. We've scheduled property-office pickup for Wednesday at 1000. I should note that the inspection sheet is still in the shop binder and has not yet been entered in the maintenance control log — we'll get that submitted.
